subject: Commercial readiness & procurement pulse — PO vs card + marketplace interest
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Ramanathan <asha.r@nimbushealth.com>, Devon Miles <devon.miles@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood demo + procurement checklist

Hi Asha / Devon,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate you walking us through the current inference use cases at Nimbus. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on procurement readiness and the commercial path.

Recap (from our call):
- Primary use: real-time clinical summarization for inbound patient notes (low single-digit qps, sensitive PHI).
- Priority: predictable latency and data isolation; plan to start on Redwood Dedicated, likely expand to Private later.
- Procurement preference: procurement team will drive vendor onboarding; unclear yet whether PO or corporate card will be used.
- Marketplace: you mentioned your internal procurement marketplace (vendor catalog) — want to confirm if Redwood needs to be listed there or if direct procurement is preferred.

Action items / asks from Nimbus:
1) What payment method do you typically use for this tier of vendor (PO vs card)? Timeline for PO approvals?
2) Are you interested in contracting via a public cloud marketplace (we can provide marketplace pricing and listing info) or direct vendor contracting?
3) Procurement checklist: vendor registration form, W9, SOC2 report, support contacts, sample SOW. If helpful, I can send our standard forms.

Proposed next steps:
- I can send vendor registration + SOW template today (attached) — please share the appropriate procurement contact if different from Asha/Devon.
- If PO is the path, can you share expected approval date range so we can plan reserved capacity slots?
- Marissa (CC) will coordinate technical onboarding once commercial is in motion.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if useful.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood demo + procurement checklist

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Payment method: For vendors of this nature we typically use a PO. Card payments are usually for lower-dollar SaaS renewals and one-off purchases; anything requiring a data processing review or SOW goes via PO.
- Marketplace: We are not planning to onboard through the marketplace right now — procurement prefers direct contracting for vendors that handle PHI.
- Required items: vendor registration form, W9, signed SOC2 attestation (or access to report), insurance certificate, and a draft SOW.

Estimated timeline: I can get the initial package into our vendor onboarding queue by 7/06, and we typically see vendor approval + PO issuance in 2–3 weeks after submission (so likely by 7/20–7/27), assuming no major gaps in documentation or contracting.

Assignees:
- Procurement contact: Asha Ramanathan (me) — I'll own the vendor packet.
- Legal/commercial questions will loop in our GC if any unusual terms show up.

Please send the vendor form + sample SOW and a preferred billing email/accounting contact so I can include that information.

Thanks,
Asha Ramanathan
Procurement Manager, Nimbus Health
asha.r@nimbushealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4602
